about: v6 cases for evcheck, written on 2026-11-17 before evcheck 0.6.0 was written; every label was fixed when the case was written. kind: correct (true, joining facts from different source lines; should pass), error (one fact changed or invented; should be flagged), row (a figure from another month's row; should be flagged), limit (worked out from the sources; flagged on purpose), skip (no number and no quote).
